scope: Selected AddModifier payloads containing only ModifierName plus a non-empty DynamicValues mapping, where the target Modifier has an explicit canonical supported Stacking definition.
selected_model: At modifier-add evaluation, evaluate each DynamicValues entry through the existing unified DynamicValue resolver and persist the named Decimal values on the immutable pending ModifierInstance. On selected Replace/Merge/Prolong refresh, the incoming mapping replaces the stored mapping together with the selected lifecycle refresh transition. No DynamicValues input is silently discarded.
ordering: Values are evaluated before add_or_refresh. The instance remains TO_BE_ADDED until the pre-existing activation boundary; this packet does not dispatch its callback body.

evidence.support: selected PostfixExpr and immutable value representation

unsupported_boundary: chance, lifetime, layer/stack overrides, caster inheritance, custom offsets, callback registration/activation, and dynamic-value lookup by a later modifier callback instance are separate tickets.
This packet does not claim a Golden game trace.
dsh_implementation_contract: Store modifier-local dynamic values on the modifier instance, not on a global owner key. Preserve the source names exactly. When a selected stacking policy refreshes an instance, update this mapping atomically with its lifecycle data; do not drop it.
